jobs.title: Consultant - IOS Developer
jobs.description:
Job Title : Senior iOS Developer (Native) - Contract
Experience - 5+ years
No. of positions : Offshore - 1
Location : Bangalore
Work Schedule: Contract for 4 to 6 months. Can convert to Full time based on performance
Work Mode: Onsite | Shift Timing: 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM [Flexible]
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced Senior Native iOS Developer to design, develop, and maintain high-quality iOS applications. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Swift, iOS SDK, UIKit/SwiftUI, application architecture, REST APIs, CleverTap integrations, Scan Go functionality, product variant implementation, performance optimization, testing, and App Store deployment .
The candidate will work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, QA, and other developers to build scalable, secure, high-performance, and user-friendly mobile applications.
Key Responsibilities
    • Design, develop, test, and maintain native iOS applications using Swift .
    • Build scalable, maintainable, and high-performance mobile applications.
    • Translate business and product requirements into technical solutions.
    • Participate in application architecture and technical design discussions.
    • Develop reusable UI components and frameworks.
    • Integrate REST APIs and third-party services.
    • Implement and maintain CleverTap SDK integration for customer engagement, analytics, and marketing use cases.
    • Implement Scan Go / Scan-and-Pay functionality for retail and commerce applications.
    • Develop barcode/QR code scanning capabilities using native iOS frameworks and/or third-party scanning SDKs.
    • Implement product and product variant management within the mobile application.
    • Integrate product catalog APIs to retrieve and display product variants such as size, color, style, pack size, flavor, configuration, or other variant attributes .
    • Implement product variant selection and validation based on availability, inventory, pricing, promotions, and business rules .
    • Ensure the selected product variant is correctly represented throughout the product detail, cart, checkout, payment, and order flows.
    • Handle variant-specific SKU/item IDs, pricing, inventory, images, attributes, and promotional information .
    • Implement product variant selection, switching, quantity updates, and cart synchronization.
    • Ensure accurate product and variant information when products are added through Scan Go .
    • Handle cases where a scanned product maps to multiple variants or requires additional variant selection.
    • Integrate Scan Go flows with product catalog, pricing, promotions, inventory, shopping cart/basket, checkout, payment, and order services .
    • Implement secure checkout and payment flows associated with Scan Go.
    • Track product, product variant, Scan Go, cart, checkout, and purchase events through CleverTap .
    • Optimize product browsing, variant selection, scanning, cart, and checkout experiences for speed and reliability.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve complex production and application issues.
    • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
    • Mentor junior and mid-level developers and provide technical guidance.
Required Technical Skills
iOS Development
Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Swift
    • iOS SDK
    • UIKit
    • SwiftUI
    • Xcode
    • Auto Layout
    • Programmatic UI and/or Storyboards
    • iOS application lifecycle
    • Background processing
    • Push notifications
    • Deep linking
    • Local storage and data persistence
    • App lifecycle and state management
Architecture Design
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture.
    • Experience with MVVM, MVC, Clean Architecture, VIPER , or similar patterns.
    • Strong understanding of SOLID principles and design patterns.
    • Experience designing modular, scalable, and testable applications.
    • Experience with dependency injection and reusable components.
APIs Integrations
    • Strong experience integrating RESTful APIs .
    • Experience with JSON parsing and API error handling.
    • Understanding of OAuth 2.0 and token-based authentication.
    • Experience integrating third-party SDKs and services.
    • Strong hands-on experience with CleverTap iOS SDK .
    • Experience with barcode/QR code scanning SDKs and integrations.
    • Experience integrating commerce APIs for:
    • Products
    • Product variants
    • Categories
    • Pricing
    • Promotions
    • Inventory
    • Cart/Basket
    • Checkout
    • Payments
    • Orders
    • Experience handling variant-level SKU/item identifiers and inventory .
Product Product Variant Implementation
Strong hands-on experience implementing product and product variant functionality in mobile commerce applications.
The candidate should have experience with:
    • Product catalog integration.
    • Product detail pages.
    • Product variants and variant attributes.
    • Variant selection based on attributes such as size, color, style, pack size, flavor, or configuration .
    • Variant-specific SKU/item IDs.
    • Variant-specific pricing and promotions.
    • Variant-level inventory and availability.
    • Variant-specific product images and content.
    • Dynamic variant selection and UI updates.
    • Handling dependent or combination-based variants.
    • Validating variant availability before adding to cart.
    • Maintaining the selected variant across product, cart, checkout, and order flows.
    • Updating quantity for specific variants.
    • Removing or switching variants in the cart.
    • Handling unavailable or discontinued variants.
    • Managing price or inventory changes between product selection and checkout.
    • Integrating product variant information with backend commerce services.
    • Tracking product and variant interactions for analytics and customer engagement.
Scan Go / Retail Commerce
Strong understanding and hands-on experience with Scan Go or similar retail mobile commerce functionality.
Experience should include:
    • Barcode and/or QR code scanning.
    • Camera-based scanning using native iOS capabilities.
    • Product identification and product information retrieval.
    • Product and product variant identification and selection.
    • Mapping scanned barcodes to the correct product/SKU/variant.
    • Handling products with multiple variants.
    • Product catalog and inventory integration.
    • Variant-level pricing and inventory validation.
    • Pricing and promotion validation.
    • Add-to-cart and cart management.
    • Quantity updates and product removal.
    • Real-time cart synchronization.
    • Customer identification and authentication.
    • Checkout and payment integration.
    • Order creation and confirmation.
    • Handling invalid, duplicate, or unavailable products.
    • Handling network failures and cart synchronization issues.
    • Performance optimization for rapid consecutive scans.
    • Secure handling of customer and transaction information.
CleverTap Integration
Strong practical experience with CleverTap integration in native iOS applications , including:
    • CleverTap SDK setup and configuration.
    • User identification and profile management.
    • Tracking custom events and user actions.
    • Push notification registration and handling.
    • Deep-link and notification click handling.
    • In-app notification integration.
    • Campaign and engagement event tracking.
    • Tracking product, product variant, Scan Go, cart, checkout, and purchase events .
    • Passing relevant product/variant attributes in event payloads.
    • Ensuring reliable event delivery and correct event payloads.
    • Debugging CleverTap event and notification integration issues.
    • Working with product/marketing teams to support customer engagement use cases.
Concurrency Performance
    • Strong understanding of Swift Concurrency / async-await .
    • Experience with GCD and multithreading.
    • Ability to identify and resolve memory leaks and retain cycles.
    • Experience optimizing API calls, product loading, image loading, scanning, variant selection, cart operations, and checkout flows.
    • Experience using Xcode Instruments and other profiling tools.
Testing Quality
    • Experience with XCTest and unit testing.
    • Experience with UI and automation testing.
    • Understanding of testable architecture and code coverage.
    • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.
    • Ability to test complex product variant scenarios.
    • Ability to test end-to-end Scan Go variant selection cart checkout payment order journeys.
    • Ability to validate analytics, notification, and CleverTap event implementations.
Build Release
    • Experience with Git ( Azure devops) and source control.
    • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for iOS applications.
    • Hands-on experience with:
    • Xcode build and archive
    • Provisioning profiles
    • Certificates and signing
    • TestFlight
    • App Store deployment
    • Experience with Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms is an advantage.
Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
    • Experience building retail, eCommerce, or consumer mobile applications .
    • Experience with Scan Go / Scan Pay / self-checkout solutions.
    • Strong experience with product catalog and product variant implementation .
    • Experience with complex product configurations and variant combinations.
    • Strong hands-on experience with SwiftUI .
    • Experience with CleverTap, Firebase, or similar customer engagement/analytics platforms .
    • Experience with barcode/QR scanning technologies.
    • Experience with payment gateway integrations.
    • Experience with Apple Pay.
    • Experience with deep linking and push notifications.
    • Experience with analytics, crash reporting, and application monitoring.
    • Experience with accessibility and localization.
    • Experience with high-scale consumer-facing applications.
Experience
    • 5+ years of software development experience , with significant hands-on experience in native iOS development.
    • Strong commercial experience developing and supporting production iOS applications.
    • Hands-on experience with CleverTap integration .
    • Hands-on experience with Scan Go / retail commerce functionality is highly preferred.
    • Hands-on experience with product catalog and product variant implementation in an eCommerce or retail application.
    • Proven experience working on complex applications involving APIs, third-party integrations, analytics, push notifications, product/catalog, cart/checkout, payment, and order flows.
    • Experience taking applications through development, testing, release, and production support.
Education
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
